messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}! You're
going to be so thrilled.
Look!
{07 14 00}I'm wearing the lovely
{0b 02 00}{04 1b 00} you
sent me!
{07 17 00}And it looks pretty good on
me, too, if I do say so
myself.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0a 00}It's exactly what I needed,
and I love it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Thank you so much!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}! Sa saad
nii elevil olema.
Vaata!
{07 14 00}Ma kannan seda armsat
{0b 02 00}{04 1b 00}, mille
sa mulle saatsid!
{07 17 00}Ja see sobib mulle ka päris
hästi, kui ma ise nii
öelda tohin.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0a 00}See on täpselt see, mida
vajasin! Super, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Suur aitäh!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}{01 06 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}{01 07 00},
I'm so happy to see you!

{07 14 00}I got your letter, and it
made me so happy. I love
getting mail!
But then, I opened it up
and saw that incredible
{07 0a 00}{0b 02 00}{04 1b 00}!
You really shouldn't have.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}But I'm so glad you did! It
fits perfectly, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}{01 06 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}{01 07 00},
ma olen nii rõõmus näha!

{07 14 00}Ma sain su kirja ja see
tegi mu nii rõõmsaks. Mulle
meeldib posti saada!
Aga siis avasin ma selle
ja nägin seda uskumatut
{07 0a 00}{0b 02 00}{04 1b 00}!
Sa poleks pidanud.{01 00 00 0a 00}
{07 14 00}Aga ma olen rõõmus! See
sobib täiuslikult, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Heya{01 07 00},
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}.

{07 17 00}Did you notice I'm wearing
the {0b 02 00}{04 1b 00}
you sent me?
{07 14 00}I don't mean to sound vain,
but{01 00 00 05 00} I look fabulous in it,
don't I, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
It's OK. You can tell me the
truth. I won't let it go to
my head.
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Terekest{01 07 00},
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 1f 00}.

{07 17 00}Kas sa märkasid, et ma
kannan {0b 02 00}{04 1b 00},
mille sa saatsid?
{07 14 00}Ma ei taha edev tunduda,
aga{01 00 00 05 00} ma näen selles hea
välja, kas pole, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Pole viga. Võid mulle tõtt
öelda. Ma ei lase sel
pähe hakata.
